name: NGC 2213 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 2213, a star cluster in the Large Magellanic Cloud, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc2213-hubble
story: A dense ball of stars in the Large Magellanic Cloud. Hubble surveyed clusters like this one to test whether each really formed its stars in a single burst, as long assumed.

claims.text: NGC 2213 is a star cluster in the Large Magellanic Cloud
Program 12257 imaged NGC 2213 among Magellanic Cloud clusters to study multiple main-sequence turn-offs, which challenge the idea that clusters are simple (single-burst) stellar populations
